referenceFunction.generalComment: The data set represents the cable fixed network in Switzerland; UUID: 76f29627-3973-3627-8204-b45eae56301e
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset represents the copper cable network in Switzerland. The reference year for network traffic is 2014. The equipment is based on information in 2010 but is deemed the most actual. A lifetime of 5 years is assumed. The amount of electricity consumed is assumed to be the same as cable since the main source used does not distinguish between copper and xDSL. Both are referred to as "copper network". Amount of electricity consumed is based on the network electricity intensity (kWh/GB) information from the Telefonica Access Network reference. The functional unit = 1 GB.
